verses.na-udhu-billahi-min-sharri-l-kuffari-wam: naʿūdhu billāhi min sharri l-kuffāri wamin sharri n-naṣārā wamin sharri s-salāṭīni
wamin wazīri wajinni thumma dhī ḥiqadi fami waʿayni waʿīni wash-shayāṭīni
waẓālimi wamunāfiqi wadhī ḥasadi waman tafassaqa yā raḥmānu najjīnī
mina n-naṣārā waman qafā ṭarīqahumu yā llāhu yā ḥayyū yā man qāla ʾudʿūnī
ʾinnī daʿawtuka dhā khawfi fakhudh biyadī yā jāʿila l-ḥāli bayna l-kāfi wan-nūni
